cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(primetarget C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Generated by tools/recomp.py from build/image (see README.md)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/sources.cmake)

file(GLOB PT_RUNTIME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/src/*.cpp)

add_executable(primetarget ${PT_RUNTIME_SOURCES} ${PT_GENERATED_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(primetarget PRIVATE runtime/include generated)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(primetarget PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8 /bigobj)
    target_compile_definitions(primetarget PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS NOMINMAX)
    # the generated code is big and goto-heavy; keep optimisation but skip whole-program analysis
    set_source_files_properties(${PT_GENERATED_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/wd4102;/wd4146;/wd4244")
    target_link_options(primetarget PRIVATE /STACK:16777216)
endif()

# Copy the relocated image next to the executable, and point at the extracted game
add_custom_command(TARGET primetarget POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/image $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:primetarget>/image)
